about: Damn Got Hands is a crude 3D render of a boxer in red gloves and blue trunks. At the top he bounces in a fighting stance next to the words "ok ima fight". At the bottom the same boxer slumps on a stool, sipping water between rounds, beside a big "damn" and a small "got hands". It is a two-beat story of confidence followed by humbling defeat: you step up to fight something, expecting an easy win, and it turns out to hit back much harder than you thought. The cheap video-game look makes the beating feel even more pathetic.
origin: The format spread on Twitter in 2020, first as a joke about trying to fight intrusive thoughts and realizing "damn this hard", before the "got hands" wording took over.
usage:
The template has two text boxes. The first sits at the bottom left, next to the exhausted boxer on the stool, and labels who took the beating (often "me" plus a detail). The second sits right under "ok ima fight" and names the opponent.

Pick an opponent that sounds harmless but isn't: a math test, the first step of the stairs, a cold, sleep schedule, a level-1 enemy, a spicy noodle challenge. The bottom-left label can stay short, since the slump already tells the story.
